interface.name: zwlr_layer_shell_v1

description.summary: create surfaces that are layers of the desktop

interface.description: Clients can use this interface to assign the surface_layer role to wl_surfaces. Such surfaces are assigned to a "layer" of the output and rendered with a defined z-depth respective to each other.

request.name: get_layer_surface

description.summary: create a layer_surface from a surface

request.description: Create a layer surface for an existing wl_surface.

interface.name: zwlr_layer_surface_v1
interface.description: An interface that may be implemented by a wl_surface for surfaces that are designed to be rendered as a layer of a stacked desktop-like environment.

request.name: set_size

description.summary: sets the size of the surface

request.description: Sets the size of the surface in surface-local coordinates. The compositor will display the surface centered with respect to its anchors.

request.name: set_anchor

description.summary: configures the anchor point of the surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor anchor the surface to the specified edges and corners.

request.name: set_exclusive_zone

description.summary: configures the exclusive geometry of this surface

request.description: Requests that the compositor avoids occluding an area with other surfaces. A value of zero means the surface does not claim exclusive space.

request.name: set_margin

description.summary: sets a margin from the anchor point

request.description: Requests that the surface be placed some distance away from the anchor point on the output.

request.name: set_keyboard_interactivity
request.description: Sets keyboard interactivity for this layer surface.

description.summary: assign this layer_surface as an xdg_popup parent

request.name: ack_configure
request.description: When a configure event is received, if a client commits the surface in response to the configure event, then the client must make an ack_configure request sometime before the commit request.

event.name: configure
event.description: The compositor will suggest a size for the surface.

request.name: set_layer

description.summary: change the layer of the surface

request.description: Change the layer that the surface is rendered on.

request.name: set_exclusive_edge

description.summary: set the edge the exclusive zone applies to

request.description: Requests an edge for the exclusive zone.
